name: Jangolode Mine
summary: In Westfall’s rolling hills, the Defias Brotherhood works Jangolode Mine for itself. The mine once supplied Stormwind City with ore and raw materials.

sections.title: A Plundered Resource
sections.body: Before Westfall declined, Jangolode Mine sent metals to Stormwind City for its reconstruction and supply. As civil order weakened and the kingdom withdrew its garrisons, the Defias Brotherhood seized the mine to support its own operations. The bandits now work its rich veins and defend the shafts fiercely.

faq.answer: Jangolode Mine is an excavation site in Westfall that once supplied Stormwind City with essential minerals and metal ore. When regional defenses weakened, it fell into hostile hands.

faq.q: Who controls the mine right now?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood controls the underground shafts after driving out the original miners. The bandits work the mine for their own operations.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind not reclaim the mine?
faq.answer: Stormwind is caught in political unrest and struggles to protect even its core borders. The kingdom lacks troops to garrison Westfall’s outlying mines, leaving the People’s Militia and local adventurers to face the threat.

angles.text: Jangolode Mine has rich deposits of basic copper and tin, making it lucrative for prospectors willing to fight past the subterranean pests.
Reclaiming Westfall’s resources matters to the kingdom’s stability. Driving the bandits out of Jangolode is one step toward restoring the region’s prosperity.
